item.title: Rubbish/litter including food waste on the street, 13th August
item.description:
Food waste, bags of rubbish, cigarette butts all over the street and in the rain gardens on Melbourne Avenue and Green Lanes. It’s disgusting. Really needs a street clean. It’s frustrating for residents as people come to the area and leave rubbish. We have to walk through it on way to work etc. It’s unhygienic- we shouldn’t have to wade through litter as we walk! This needs to be a priority location and I would suggest more needs to be done to deter people from littering- more enforcement? Work with businesses? It must be frustrating for the waste team too.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Green Lanes, Southgate

item.title: Flag on lampost, 13th August
item.description:
I reported this back in April, over 3 months ago. Can I be given a time frame for the removal? It has become an eyesore and a danger to passing cars if it became loose. This flag was put up a few months ago and I expected it to be removed by now. It is directly outside my bedroom window and when the weather is particularly bad, it can make a lot of noise which disturbs mine and my partners sleep. Furthermore, it is an eyesore, devaluing the property and does not represent my views.

item.title: Public bin overflowing, 13th August
item.description:
This bin is full and overflowing again, with a bag of rubbish left next to it. Please can collections of all these local public bins be increased in this hot weather... I think people are dumping household waste because of the smell/maggots in their own bins and only fortnightly non-recyclable collections. Perhaps encouraging people to use their weekly food waste bins instead could be a good message to put out there?

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Parish Lane, Penge, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Car on corner, 13th August
item.description:
Thus small grey car has been parked right on corner of Chaucer road & Canterbury making turning into and out of Chaucer road difficult to do especially turning into Chaucer road, especially when a car is exiting Chaucer road & with parked cars in Canterbury avenue. In fact it has been very difficult for the waste disposal lorry to turn out of road & for delivery vans/trucks to turn. The car had been there for a week with one side window partly open and no movement. Is it abandoned? If not, surely it is illegal to park so near to junction to stop cars from turning/exiting roadway. A double yellow line should be placed on the small area of road leading to a drop down drive (87 canterbury) to stop this keep occurring.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 59, Chaucer Road, Albany Park, Sidcup, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
